title: Sage chat — grounding family
notes: Promotes the existing `grounding` family of scripts/sage-chat-harness.mjs (3 cases today) to a gated numeric metric. Spawned unmodified via `--families=grounding --provider=openrouter --model=google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite`; reads the harness's own byFamily.grounding bucket. Floor 1.0 per the design table (§4.2): grounding failures mean a fabricated or unsupported claim, which this repo treats as zero-tolerance. Expanding to the 30-golden-Q&A corpus the design calls for is future work, not part of this promotion. The nightly hermetic Postgres has no ProgramDocument rows unless `scripts/bench/seed-catalog-corpus.mjs` runs (wired in benchmarks.yml and in this scorer); without that seed every case reports `got: none`. The scorer sets SAGE_RAG_MODE=keyword because the hermetic DB has catalog notes but no embeddings — hybrid returning [] does not fall through to keyword scoring. rag-retrieval remains the hybrid-quality instrument against prod-readonly. Since 2026-10-15 the harness calls production's model, google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite, through OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), because the repository's GEMINI_API_KEY secret was rejected by Google. The fixture is synthetic, so OpenRouter never sees student data (docs/runbooks/openrouter-test-bench.md). OpenRouter cannot pass production's Gemini safetySettings, so replies are the model on OpenRouter's defaults. The harness runs with an empty GEMINI_API_KEY, so it cannot call Google directly.
